name: Named Query APIs
description:
Use Named Query APIs to create custom Salesforce Object Query Language (SOQL) queries that you can expose in REST API calls.

Follow [these instructions](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_rest.meta/api_rest/resources_named_query_setup.htm) to create your first Named Query API and call it in Postman with this request template.
